name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by late-night races watched with his grandfather. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Porto, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before interning at a small racing outfit in Vila Real. His analytical mind and ability to see the big picture quickly made him an invaluable asset, leading him to focus on race strategy.

Ricardo thrives under pressure, meticulously analyzing data to predict competitor moves and optimize race pace. He's known for his conservative yet effective strategies, prioritizing consistency and minimizing risks. While some might see him as overly cautious, his approach has consistently delivered solid results. He recently joined Sprint V8 Team, drawn by their ambition and commitment to long-term success, eager to guide them to victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo has a focused gaze and a slightly weathered face, reflecting years spent analyzing data under pressure.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out copy of 'The Art of War'.
Has a specific routine of checking weather forecasts from three different sources before every race.
Insists on using a physical notepad and pen alongside his digital tools.
